gaps.what: bb-hook fail-open exits are not recorded by hook-hub
gaps.why: bb-hook prints nothing and exits 0 when the hub is down, stalled or out of budget, so a hook that never reached hook-hub leaves no receipt. Client-side timing comes from the CLI transcript (hook_success durationMs) where the CLI logs it

gaps.what: handler stdout/stderr not stored by hook-hub
gaps.why: receipts keep status, reason, timings and the wrapper's exit code only; the injected text survives only in the CLI transcript or rollout

gaps.what: consumer inventory is a snapshot at capture time, not at the turn
gaps.why: /jsz and /connz were read 3382 s after the turn; consumers created or removed in between are not reflected, and ack floors have moved on
capture file absent (deleted at session end or never created): buffered text is not recoverable

findings.title: code-review-graph-status never runs: binary not on hook-hub PATH
findings.detail: hook-hub skipped code-review-graph-status 1 time in this turn with reason handler_binary_missing. The hub runs with a system PATH (/usr/local/sbin:...:/snap/bin) that has no mise shims and no ~/.local/bin, so concerns.py executable() never finds the handler binary and the handler is dead.

findings.title: ASM never reaches 'gone' for session-keyed scopes
findings.detail: codex:s:01a1e2cd-ef5a-7831-86ab-4eacacdac661 is keyed by the native session id (pid recorded as 0). SessionEnd/Stop only quiesce it; the sweeper cannot prove a sid scope gone, so it just expires 900 s after the last edge.
